reports.summary_en: After a strict pass over arXiv, public project pages, lab and company research pages, GitHub, and related research sources, I did not find any genuinely new item since the last successful run that met the bar for dexterous robot hands or dexterous manipulation. The nearby candidates visible today were either general bimanual or humanoid teleoperation work that did not center dexterous hands, or they were relevant but first public before the previous successful run, so they are not added in this report.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`MANGO-Grasp`。它把跨具身灵巧抓取作为核心问题，结合几何导向的 3D Gaussian 原语与带形态-运动学信息的机器人描述，在已见与未见手型上都报告了有说服力的仿真和真实实验结果，因此属于本次明确新增条目。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `MANGO-Grasp`. It targets cross-embodiment dexterous grasping as the central problem and combines geometry-oriented 3D Gaussian primitives with morpho-kinematic robot descriptors, reporting convincing simulation and real-world results on both seen and unseen hand embodiments, so it is a clear new addition for this run.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 2 项新的高相关工作：`TacWAM` 与 `FasTac`。前者把机械感知触觉预测纳入世界-动作模型，并在真实接触丰富任务上显著优于视觉和既有多模态基线；后者则面向灵巧操作曲面指尖，统一解决高精度三维形状重建、三轴力估计与高速边缘部署问题，属于灵巧手感知侧的实质新增进展。
reports.summary_en: This run found 2 newly relevant items: `TacWAM` and `FasTac`. TacWAM brings mechanics-aware tactile prediction into a world-action model and reports strong gains on real contact-rich tasks over visual and prior multimodal baselines; FasTac targets curved fingertips for dexterous manipulation and jointly addresses high-precision 3D reconstruction, three-axis force estimation, and high-speed edge deployment, so it is a substantive sensing-side addition for dexterous hands.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`UniCross`。它把抓取、重定位、内旋转和内平移统一到同一套灵巧操作表述中，强调跨技能一致性、长程组合和对不同手型的迁移，属于与灵巧机器人手/灵巧操作直接相关的实质新增进展。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `UniCross`. It unifies grasping, relocation, in-hand rotation, and in-hand translation under one dexterous-manipulation formulation, emphasizing cross-skill consistency, long-horizon composition, and transfer across hand morphologies, so it is a substantive new item directly tied to dexterous robot hands and dexterous manipulation.

Overall, there was no large wave of brand-new papers, but this update still represents a substantive step directly tied to dexterous manipulation.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 2 项新的高相关工作，均聚焦触觉驱动的接触丰富灵巧操作：`N0-VTLA` 与 `N0-TWAM`。前者统一建模视觉、触觉、语言与动作，并在真实灵巧手任务上取得强结果；后者把触觉作为原生模态来预测未来视觉、触觉和动作，覆盖多具身、多任务基准。整体来看，这一轮新增内容集中在“触觉原生化的灵巧操作基础模型”，而不是单点硬件公告。
reports.summary_en: This run found 2 newly relevant items centered on tactile-driven contact-rich dexterous manipulation: `N0-VTLA` and `N0-TWAM`. The former unifies vision, tactile, language, and action and reports strong real-robot dexterous-hand results; the latter treats touch as a native modality for predicting future vision, touch, and action across multi-embodiment, multi-task benchmarks. Overall, the new material is concentrated on tactile-native manipulation foundation models rather than isolated hardware announcements.

reports.summary: 本轮补录了 3 项此前未进入 seen 状态、但与灵巧机器人手或灵巧操作直接相关的新公开工作：`Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation`、`Current as Touch` 和 `A Monolithic Hand with Asymmetric Origami Bending and Dual-chamber Actuators`。其中前两项更偏向灵巧操作控制与触觉/本体感觉闭环，后一项则是强调易制造与被动顺应性的软体灵巧手硬件。整体看，这一轮没有出现大规模新潮，但出现了几个足够扎实且可继续跟踪的增量条目。
reports.summary_en: This run adds 3 previously untracked items that are directly relevant to dexterous robot hands or dexterous manipulation: `Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation`, `Current as Touch`, and `A Monolithic Hand with Asymmetric Origami Bending and Dual-chamber Actuators`. The first two focus on dexterous teleoperation and proprioception/tactile-like feedback, while the third is a soft dexterous hand hardware contribution emphasizing manufacturability and passive compliance. There was no large wave of new releases, but these are solid incremental items worth tracking further.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations`。它把“想象触觉”用于接触丰富的灵巧操作，在不依赖真实触觉硬件的前提下，利用视觉和本体感觉生成触觉表征，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上验证了收益。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations`. It applies imagined tactile representations to contact-rich dexterous manipulation, generating tactile cues from vision and proprioception without physical tactile hardware, and validates the approach in simulation and real-world robot tasks.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`VT-WAM: Visual-Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation`。它把视觉、触觉变形预测与动作预测统一到同一模型中，直接面向接触丰富的灵巧操作，并在 6 个真实任务上报告了明显优于已有方法的结果。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `VT-WAM: Visual-Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation`. It unifies visual prediction, tactile deformation prediction, and action prediction for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, and reports strong gains over prior methods on six real-world tasks.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations`。它把想象触觉直接用于接触丰富的灵巧操作，并提供了方法、基准与真实机器人验证，符合本追踪器的严格收录标准。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations`. It directly uses imagined tactile representations for contact-rich dexterous manipulation and includes a method, benchmark, and real-robot validation, which fits the tracker’s strict inclusion bar.

reports.summary_en: This run found three new items directly related to dexterous robot hands, covering new hardware, a data/code suite, and a low-cost in-hand manipulation solution.

reports.summary: 本轮发现 3 项与灵巧机器人手直接相关的新进展，分别聚焦自动化灵巧抓取数据采集、双手灵巧遥操作，以及面向连续灵巧人形机动操作的协调策略。
reports.summary_en: This run surfaced three new items directly relevant to dexterous robot hands: automated dexterous grasping data collection, bimanual dexterous teleoperation, and coordinated policies for continuous dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation.

reports.summary_en: This run found four new items directly relevant to dexterous robot hands or dexterous manipulation, covering a new dexterous-hand joint, contact-aware in-hand manipulation, long-horizon dexterous manipulation reasoning, and dataset construction from everyday human videos.

reports.summary: 本轮检索发现 1 项新的高相关条目：一篇面向共体式可穿戴机器人手的变量自主权方法论文。它把人机共享单一物理身体、在不同任务阶段切换自主等级作为核心贡献，且包含真实用户研究与量化结果，因此属于本轮最值得跟踪的新增进展。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: a paper on variable autonomy for a co-embodied wearable robotic hand. It makes human-robot co-embodiment over a single physical body the central contribution, and it includes a real user study with quantitative results, so it is the most important new item to track in this run.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`VibeAct`，它把振动信号用于接触丰富的反应式灵巧操作控制，主题与灵巧机器人手直接相关，且发布时间晚于上一轮成功运行，因此应作为新增条目收录。整体来看，本轮没有发现大量新文献，但这项工作在触觉感知与灵巧操作闭环控制之间建立了清晰连接，值得继续跟进其后续代码与实机结果。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `VibeAct`, which uses vibration signals for contact-rich reactive robot dexterity. It is directly aligned with dexterous robot hands and was published after the previous successful run, so it should be added as a new item. No broad wave of new papers appeared in this run, but this work is notable because it connects tactile sensing to closed-loop dexterous manipulation in a concrete way.

Some recent items around tactile sensing, grasping, or robot manipulation appeared in search results, but they were either earlier than already tracked content or did not meet the strict bar that dexterous hands or dexterous manipulation must be central contributions, so no items were added.

reports.summary: 本轮发现 1 项新的高相关工作：`Play2Perfect`。它把多指灵巧手的“玩耍式预训练”与精密装配直接连接起来，围绕抓取、手内重定向和位姿到达学习可复用的操作先验，并给出明显的样本效率提升和零样本仿真到真实转移结果，因此值得新增收录。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly relevant item: `Play2Perfect`. It directly connects dexterous play pretraining for multi-finger hands to precise assembly, learns reusable manipulation priors for grasping, in-hand reorientation, and pose reaching, and reports strong sample-efficiency gains plus zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, so it should be added.
